levels.surface: عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك

notes: «وحدناه» opens the report: the earlier isnad it refers to is not in this text, so nothing is inherited.
A stray «لا» before «عن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك» is read as a scanning artefact and left out.
«بمثل حديث ابن وهب» names another transmitter: a variant group, never a route.
